arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('src/eywa/offline.py')
s = p.read_text()
old_start = s.index('    def _analyse(self, plan, key, values):')
old_end = s.index('    def _filters_accept(self, plan, values):')
new = '''    def _analyse(self, plan, key, values):
        """`(accepts, filters accept, status, cost, commands)` per input.

        The verdict depends only on the recovered input values, so it is
        cached by corpus identity and shared by every witness of one input.
        """
        module = plan.module
        accepted = True
        if module.requires is not None and not module.requires(values):
            accepted = False
        filters = True
        if accepted or plan.flag is not None:
            filters = self._filters_accept(plan, values)
        if not accepted or not filters:
            return (accepted, filters, "FILTERED", 0, [])
        if self.machine is None:
            return (accepted, filters, "OK", 0, [])
        preparation = self._preparation.get(key, _MISSING)
        if preparation is _MISSING:
            preparation = self._prepare(plan, values)
            self._preparation[key] = preparation
        if preparation is None:
            return (accepted, filters, "UNREACHABLE", 0, [])
        cost, commands = preparation
        message = values.get(self.machine.message_param)
        if not isinstance(message, str):
            message = ""
        return (accepted, filters, "OK", cost, list(commands) + [message])

'''
s = s[:old_start] + new + s[old_end:]
s = s.replace('''            if not verdict[0] or not verdict[1]:
                records.append({"status": "FILTERED"})
                continue
            cost, commands = verdict[2], verdict[3]''',
'''            if verdict[2] == "FILTERED":
                records.append({"status": "FILTERED"})
                continue
            if verdict[2] == "UNREACHABLE":
                records.append({"status": "UNREACHABLE"})
                continue
            cost, commands = verdict[3], verdict[4]''')
p.write_text(s)
PYEOF
grep -n "verdict" src/eywa/offline.py | head -30; python3 /workspace/tmp/t_state.py
